verdict.rationale: Beamer collects and prioritizes feedback and runs NPS surveys to identify trends, but none of this is documented as AI-driven. Its only documented AI feature generates changelog posts, which is a different capability from decluttering raw feedback or surfacing high-impact opportunities. This axis fairly applies to a feedback and roadmap tool, but the evidence shows no AI feedback analysis.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI to declutter raw feedback and surface the most impactful opportunities
